title: Herobrines Omen
description: A myth that comes to life within your world. He’s watching you...
body:
Herobrine’s Omen brings new levels of terror to Minecraft by introducing multiple versions of Herobrine, each with their own behavior. Some will stalk you from a distance. Others will attack without warning, or even mine through the world to reach you. Over time, herobrine will become more active. Nowhere is truly safe.
Discover mysterious structures and events that hint at Herobrine’s presence, and brace yourself for sudden jumpscares. Some Jumpscares are so powerful that they can even kick you out of your own world. You thought he was just a myth… but now, he’s here.

## **Updates continue on Curseforge** ##

- A mod made by Zcoper
- Mod created with MCreator!
- Requires Geckolib

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>



► [OLD] What is my console spaming?

Most mobs use special spawning conditions, which means that these mobs can only appear under certain conditions. If the spawning conditions work, this spam is created in the console.

► [OLD] Why can't I summon a mob?

Spawning Conditions determine which conditions must be met in order to spawn certain mobs. Some mobs only spawn above Y level 60. Some below. Most mobs can only spawn in the overworld than in other dimensions.

► Why are features missing in different versions?

It is recommended to play the newest versions of higher minecraft versions.

Not all features of MCreator available or the same in different versions.
For example: Version 1.19.2 doesn't have the feature of shield, better structure generation or custom villagers, but Version 1.20.1 does have them.

► How does the Phases work?

Through the phases that increase up to phase 4, Herobrine becomes more aggressive.


Phase 0
Mossy Cobblestone pyramids, Redstone torch tunnels, mysterious signs, fake Bedrock crosses can occur.

Phase 1
Herobrine Stalkers appear, new eerie events occur.

Phase 2
Cursed Animals, Weeping Herobrine, Sky Stalker Herobrine, additional new events.

Phase 3
Herobrine Builder, Herobrine Knockbacker, Herobrine Stalker Near, Herobrine Circle, new events and Herobrine short jumpscare can occur.

Phase 4
Herobrine Hunter and Herobrine Mage appear, Herobrine Boss can be summoned, new events, Herobrine long jumpscare can occur.

► How to change phases?

Phases are reset to 0 if the Herobrine Boss got defeated by a player.

Alternatively, you can use the command "herobrine_add_phases" to increase the phase by one.
The phases are reset to 0 with the command “herobrine_reset_phases”.

► How to disable Herobrine Buildings?

Herobrine Buildings can be switched off using the gamerule "herobrineBuilderBuilds" if it is set to false. 

► How to disable being kicked out?

Being kicked out can be switched off using the gamerule "kickOutFromWorld" if it is set to false. 

► How to disable Herobrine Jumpscares?

Herobrine Jumpscares can be switched off using the gamerule "herobrineJumpscares" if it is set to false. 

► How to summon the Herobrine Boss?

To summon the Herobrine Boss, the player must already be in Phase 4. The summoning process requires constructing a special altar:

Place a Mossy Cobblestone as the center block.

Surround it with Gold Blocks on all four sides.

Place Netherrack on top of the Mossy Cobblestone.

Place Redstone Torches next to the Netherrack on the Gold Blocks.

Light the Netherrack on fire.

► Events

From Phase 0:

> Mossy Cobblestone Pyramids
> Signs with various messages
> Underground tunnels with Redstone torches
> Crosses made of Fake Bedrock blocks
> Redstone torches appearing under the player
> Message: "Player [Name] not found."
> Message: "[ERROR] Failed to remove entity 72-69-82-79-66-82-73-78-69"
> Message: "[Name] joined the game"
> Message: "[Name] left the game"

From Phase 1:

> Title: "Who are you?"
> Fake Bedrock floating in the air
> Chest with Redstone Dust spelling "Hi"
> Footstep sounds behind the player
> Creeper sound behing a player
> Random Cave Sound
> Message: [Render thread/Warn]: Invalid render entity (ID: -1)
> Message: Local game hosted on port [58642]
> Message: Herobrine joined the game
> >>Answer within 30 seconds with Herobrine or hi/hey/hello... will eventually kick you from the world or getting a reply
> Unknown Entity with a Nametag can spawn

From Phase 2:

> Fake Diamond Block that explodes when mined
> Breathing sound
> Actionbar: "Now Playing: C418 - Die"
> Random damage
> Message: <Herobrine> Hello
> >>Answer within 30 seconds with Herobrine or hi/hey/hello... will eventually kick you from the world or getting a reply

From Phase 3:

> Title: "You can't hide"
> Message: "Shutting down internal server..."
> Disc 13 starts playing
> Random Herobrine Scream
> Message: OpenGL Error: 1282 (Invalid operation)
> >>With following messages

From Phase 4:

> Title: "LEAVE LEAVE LEAVE LEAVE LEAVE"

</details>



![Herobrine](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fb02fd2436e4d5f6c33d506d9a37ea675676fd7.png)

Herobrine is a terrifying presence that can take on different forms, each with its own behavior depending on what phase he is. Immune to many types of attacks, Herobrine can randomly appear in front of or behind the player, occasionally triggering jumpscares. Depending on the variant, it might be fast, incredibly strong, or able to withstand significant damage, and when defeated, it can drop a variety of random loot.
